brief.summary: Six advisories and many independent news reports agree that Cyclone Remal is crossing the Sundarbans coast between West Bengal and Bangladesh around the stated time, and flooding and surge are already reported. The track has drifted west across advisories, and there are no river forecasts, but both sides of the border remain exposed.

reasons.text: Six successive advisories consistently bring the storm north into the northern Bay of Bengal coast, with computed landfall near 21.8N 88.43E about one hour after the latest advisory.

reasons.text: Damage is already reported: houses flooded in Bagerhat as rivers rose above the danger mark, the Sundarbans inundated, and one death from a tidal surge in Patuakhali.
